feat(host): a wheel no app moves anything with scrolls the page (rich-demos-k78j.d24) (#380)

* feat(host): a wheel no app moves anything with scrolls the page (rich-demos-k78j.d24)

App offers every wheel notch to onWheel consumers and passes one none moved
anything with to the new required TerminalHost.passWheel. WidgetApp's one
consumer is its router's viewport scroll. NodeTerminalHost hands it to a stdout
that carries passWheel (the card's stand-in) and otherwise does nothing; the
card's worker posts it and the page scrolls by that many terminal rows.

Deviation from the ticket's design: the card's programs run on
NodeTerminalHost in the worker, so the way out is an optional passWheel on the
stdout stream rather than BrowserTerminalHost alone.

* fix(host): the vertical wheel is onWheel's alone; cards scroll the page a whole notch (rich-demos-k78j.d24)

Review (high): onMouse no longer hears scroll_up/down (AppMouseEvent), so an
app cannot move something with a turn and still pass it outward; WidgetApp
gains onWheel; only a running app is offered or passes a turn. The card
scrolls the page by the reporting event's own distance, and a terminal with
no pointer reporting leaves the wheel to the page instead of turning it into
arrow keys. e2e pointer columns come from card.json.

* fix(widgets): a wheel turn says where the pointer is; a card with no live program leaves the wheel to the page (rich-demos-k78j.d24)

Review (medium): EventRouter.wheel records the pointer and re-reads hover,
as every other pointer report does; the card's wheel handler also asks
whether a program is still running to hear the report.
